message.content:
The most visited market in New York City is **Union Square Greenmarket**.  
It’s the largest of the city’s farmers’‑market sites, drawing roughly 1–2 million visitors each year (the exact figure varies by season). Its central location, wide variety of vendors, and frequent events make it the top destination for both locals and tourists looking for fresh produce, artisanal foods, and community atmosphere.
